response: In the provided context, "Accountability" refers to the state of being answerable for actions, decisions, and performance (of an AI system). Developers must uphold their accountability to stakeholders, including users, to build trust in the AI systems they develop. Specifically, developers should provide users with necessary information to enable informed decisions when selecting and utilizing AI systems. To enhance societal acceptance of AI systems, developers should provide users with technical descriptions, algorithms, and safety mechanisms of their AI systems, seek feedback from stakeholders, and collaborate closely with suppliers to manage issues related to the provision and use of AI systems.
